{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: C/C++ CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [ master,develop ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ master,develop ]

jobs:
  linux-x86:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - name: Checkout
      uses: actions/checkout@v4
    - name: Cache APT packages
      uses: actions/cache@v4
      with:
        path: /var/cache/apt/archives
        key: ${{ runner.os }}-apt
        restore-keys: |
          ${{ runner.os }}-apt-
    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        sudo apt-get update
        sudo apt-get install gcc-multilib # bits/libc-header-start.h
    - name: Build
      run: make ARCH=x86 BUILD=c89 rc_client-test
      working-directory: test/client
    - name: Run tests
      run: ./rc_client-test
      working-directory: test/client

  linux-x64:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - name: Checkout
      uses: actions/checkout@v4
    - name: Cache APT packages
      uses: actions/cache@v4
      with:
        path: /var/cache/apt/archives
        key: ${{ runner.os }}-apt
        restore-keys: |
          ${{ runner.os }}-apt-
    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        sudo apt-get update
        sudo apt-get install valgrind gcc-multilib # bits/libc-header-start.h
    - name: Build
      run: make ARCH=x64 BUILD=c89 rc_client-test
      working-directory: test/client
    - name: Run tests
      run: ./rc_client-test
      working-directory: test/client
    - name: Valgrind
      run: make ARCH=x64 BUILD=c89 valgrind
      working-directory: test/client

  linux-x64-hash-lib:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - name: Checkout
      uses: actions/checkout@v4
    - name: Cache APT packages
      uses: actions/cache@v4
      with:
        path: /var/cache/apt/archives
        key: ${{ runner.os }}-apt
        restore-keys: |
          ${{ runner.os }}-apt-
    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        sudo apt-get update
        sudo apt-get install gcc-multilib # bits/libc-header-start.h
    - name: Build
      run: make ARCH=x64 BUILD=c89 rc_hash-test
      working-directory: test/hash
    - name: Run tests
      run: ./rc_hash-test
      working-directory: test/hash
      
  # RetroArch compiles with gcc-8, gnu99, and a different set of warnings.
  # Attempt to catch issues caused by those discrepencies.
  linux-x64-retroarch:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - name: Checkout
      uses: actions/checkout@v4
    - name: Cache APT packages
      uses: actions/cache@v4
      with:
        path: /var/cache/apt/archives
        key: ${{ runner.os }}-apt
        restore-keys: |
          ${{ runner.os }}-apt-
    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        sudo apt-get update
        sudo apt-get install valgrind gcc-multilib # bits/libc-header-start.h
    - name: Check ctype calls
      run: make ARCH=x64 BUILD=retroarch check_ctype
      working-directory: test/client
    - name: Build
      run: make ARCH=x64 BUILD=retroarch rc_client-test
      working-directory: test/client
    - name: Run tests
      run: ./rc_client-test
      working-directory: test/client
    - name: Valgrind
      run: make ARCH=x64 BUILD=retroarch valgrind
      working-directory: test/client

  linux-x64-nohash:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - name: Checkout
      uses: actions/checkout@v4
    - name: Cache APT packages
      uses: actions/cache@v4
      with:
        path: /var/cache/apt/archives
        key: ${{ runner.os }}-apt
        restore-keys: |
          ${{ runner.os }}-apt-
    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        sudo apt-get update
        sudo apt-get install valgrind gcc-multilib # bits/libc-header-start.h
    - name: Build HAVE_HASH=0
      run: make ARCH=x64 BUILD=c89 HAVE_HASH=0 rc_client-test
      working-directory: test/client
    - name: Run tests HAVE_HASH=0
      run: ./rc_client-test
      working-directory: test/client
    - name: Build HAVE_HASH_ROMS=0
      run: make ARCH=x64 BUILD=c89 clean && make ARCH=x64 BUILD=c89 HAVE_HASH_ROMS=0 rc_client-test
      working-directory: test/client
    - name: Run tests HAVE_HASH_ROMS=0
      run: ./rc_client-test
      working-directory: test/client
    - name: Build HAVE_HASH_DISC=0
      run: make ARCH=x64 BUILD=c89 clean && make ARCH=x64 BUILD=c89 HAVE_HASH_DISC=0 rc_client-test
      working-directory: test/client
    - name: Run tests HAVE_HASH_DISC=0
      run: ./rc_client-test
      working-directory: test/client
    - name: Build HAVE_HASH_ZIP=0
      run: make ARCH=x64 BUILD=c89 clean && make ARCH=x64 BUILD=c89 HAVE_HASH_ZIP=0 rc_client-test
      working-directory: test/client
    - name: Run tests HAVE_HASH_ZIP=0
      run: ./rc_client-test
      working-directory: test/client
    - name: Build HAVE_HASH_ENCRYPTED=0
      run: make ARCH=x64 BUILD=c89 clean && make ARCH=x64 BUILD=c89 HAVE_HASH_ENCRYPTED=0 rc_client-test
      working-directory: test/client
    - name: Run tests HAVE_HASH_ENCRYPTED=0
      run: ./rc_client-test
      working-directory: test/client

  windows-x64-msbuild:
    runs-on: windows-latest
    steps:
    - name: Checkout
      uses: actions/checkout@v4
    - name: Install MSBuild
      uses: microsoft/setup-msbuild@v1.0.2
    - name: Build
      run: msbuild.exe rcheevos-test.sln -t:rc_client-test -p:Configuration=Release -p:Platform=x64
      working-directory: test
    - name: Run tests
      run: ./rc_client-test.exe
      working-directory: bin/x64/Release/rc_client-test

  windows-x64-mingw:
    runs-on: windows-latest
    steps:
    - name: Checkout
      uses: actions/checkout@v4
    - name: Build
      run: make ARCH=x64 BUILD=c89 CC=gcc rc_client-test
      working-directory: test/client
    - name: Run tests
      run: ./rc_client-test.exe
      working-directory: test/client",
  "rationale": "Every Linux job repeats `sudo apt-get update` and `sudo apt-get install`, fetching the same system packages (gcc-multilib, valgrind) on each run. This is repeated dependency fetching with no existing cache, matching the P-LIT-GHA-CACHE dependency-cache pattern supported by measured experiments (Gradle cache saved 20.4% elapsed; Go module cache saved 6.06%). Adding `actions/cache@v4` for `/var/cache/apt/archives` before each apt install step reuses downloaded .deb packages across runs while preserving all build and test steps, required checks, and permissions. Windows jobs are unchanged since they do not use apt.",
  "evidence_ids": ["experiment:batch-interactive-three--91c08fe132959200", "experiment:batch-interactive-three--f6d2974a5cef7cc9"]
}
